newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-SWEDEN'S SCHWARZ MAY BE SET FOR MAN UTD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDEN'S SCHWARZ MAY BE SET FOR MAN UTD.

text.p: Swedish international midfielder Stefan Schwarz may be on the verge of signing for English league champions Manchester United, Schwarz's agent said on Thursday.
Agent Vincenzo Morabito told the Swedish news agency TT that the price tag for Schwarz, currently playing for Italy's Fiorentina, could be around seven million pounds ($11.70 million).
"I believe Stefan will take this if Fiorentina agree," Morabito said.
"I've spoken to Stefan in recent days. He has said he wouldn't say no to a comeback in England if an offer came from a really big club; and United are the biggest," he added.
Schwarz, 27, has formerly played professional soccer for Portual's Benfica and England's Arsenal. He has a contract with Fiorentina until 1998.
"I spoke to Fiorentina today. The offer is so big that they are beginning to waver," Morabito said.
Schwarz is an aggressive left-footed midfielder with a fierce shot and is known as a tough tackler. ($1=.5982 Pound)
